data.name: Voramir
data.detailed_description:
Voramir is a 3D voxel-based action RPG that combines the creative freedom of block-building with intense combat and character progression. Set in a procedurally generated dark fantasy world, you'll explore diverse biomes, battle hostile creatures, and develop your character through a deep progression system.

Core Gameplay Features:

Voxel World Building & Exploration

  • Procedural Terrain Generation: Explore vast, procedurally generated worlds with realistic terrain featuring mountains, valleys, and diverse biomes

  • Block Building & Destruction: Break and place blocks to shape your environment, build structures, and create your own settlements

  • Multiple Biomes: Journey through Safe Zones (grasslands), Normal Zones (dirt plains), Dangerous Zones (stone terrain), Deadly Zones (cobblestone), and the treacherous Hell Zone (snow-covered peaks)

Combat & Character Progression

  • Real-Time Combat System: Engage in fast-paced melee combat with multiple weapon types including swords, axes, and clubs

  • Progression: Level up to 99, gaining attribute points to distribute between Vitality, Strength, and Energy

  • Skill System: Master magical abilities including Fire Bolt and other elemental skills with cooldowns and mana costs

  • Equipment & Loot: Discover and equip weapons, armor, and magical items with randomized properties and quality levels (Normal, Magic, Rare)

  • Dynamic Magic Properties: Find items with magical prefixes and suffixes that enhance your character's abilities

RPG Mechanics

  • Character Attributes: Distribute points between Vitality (health), Strength (damage), and Energy (mana)

  • Equipment Slots: Equip weapons in 4 main hand slots and armor in chest slot

  • Health & Mana System: Manage your resources with potions and natural regeneration

  • Experience & Leveling: Gain experience by defeating enemies and level up to unlock new abilities

World & Exploration

  • Procedural Villages: Discover procedurally generated settlements with different architectural styles (Human, Elf, Orc villages)

  • Area-Based Difficulty: Face increasingly challenging enemies as you venture further from spawn

  • Enemy Variety: Battle Humans, Elves, and Orcs with unique combat behaviors and loot tables

  • Treasure System: Defeat enemies to earn loot through a sophisticated treasure class system

data.short_description: Face demonic hordes and defeat the Lord of the Abyss in this procedural action RPG. Explore vast voxel worlds, build structures, battle enemies, and level up with deep character progression. Master magical skills and discover powerful loot in this fantasy sandbox.
